rounds: I would pay 50 cents more for a drink in better packaging.
Pfand is one of the best things about living in Germany.
Recycling at home makes almost no difference to the planet.
Tap water is just as good as bottled water.
Supermarkets should sell everything unpackaged, like a market stall.
Paper straws are worse than no straw at all.
Nice packaging makes me buy things I don't need.
Governments, not shoppers, should decide which packaging is allowed.
